shortDescription: According to Wallstreetcn, Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf said the view that Iran must choose between war and negotiation is wrong, and that Iran must resist rationally and forcefully before negotiating at the appropriate time with authority and reason.

title: Iranian Parliament Speaker Qalibaf Says War-or-Negotiation Framing Is Wrong
